config.emptyProviders: No providers yet. Cline configures third-party endpoints over the openai-compatible protocol — add a provider first
config.setActiveTooltip: Set as current (writes lastUsedProvider in providers.json; Cline runs only that entry)
config.setDefaultTooltip: Set as this provider's default model
config.deleteProviderConfirm: Delete provider {name}? Its model catalog is removed as well
config.modelsEmpty: No models under this provider yet
config.providerIdHint: Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot, colon and slash; avoid renaming after creation
config.displayNameHint: Display only; falls back to the provider ID when empty
config.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; Cline appends /chat/completions itself, so usually stop at …/v1
config.apiKeyPlaceholder: Stored as plaintext apiKey in providers.json
config.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved (encrypted at rest); leave blank to keep it
config.modelIdHint: Model identifier sent to the API; may differ from the display name
config.namePlaceholder: Name shown in the model picker
config.capabilitiesHint: Declares what the model supports; missing tool / image capabilities disable those features in Cline
config.notInstalled: ~/.cline not found (Cline has not been installed or used yet)
config.entryInvalidTitle: These provider entries fail Cline's validation and Cline silently drops them (which is why the config never takes effect):
config.entryInvalidHint: Cline drops this entry: {reason}. Fix it and save again; until then it cannot be set as current.
config.noActiveWarning: The provider in use (providers.json lastUsedProvider) is {id}, but that entry is unusable — Cline silently falls back to the built-in Cline account, so your config never takes effect. Click ⭐ to pick the provider in use again.
config.reasoningInvalidHint: The reasoning effort in the file is invalid, so Cline drops the whole entry; pick an effort again to fix it
config.reasoningSaved: Reasoning effort saved (applies to Cline's next session)
config.settingsWarn: Cline strictly validates providers.json: version must be 1, updatedAt must be an ISO timestamp, and tokenSource may only be manual / oauth / migration. Cline silently drops the whole file when any of these fails, so this tool blocks writes on invalid content

mcp.tip: (cline_mcp_settings.json, shared by the CLI and IDE extensions)
mcp.enableBeforeTools: Enable this server before inspecting its tools

skill.tip: (~/.cline/skills; disabling moves the folder into a sibling .disabled/)
skill.empty: No skills installed; use “Install skill” to add one from SkillHub / ModelScope, or drop it into the folder manually

usage.emptyHint: Run a session with cline to generate {path}; ignore this if Cline is not installed or unused
usage.modelHint: Session-level totals; uncached input + cache read + cache write + output
